This episode features a heartfelt conversation with Roxane, an engineer turned wellness advocate, who shares her transformative journey and how she has helped over 350 people discover the healing powers of holistic health.

Roxane recounts her first visit to Hippocrates in 1998, where she experienced profound healing from lifelong eczema and migraines. Inspired by her transformation, she has since dedicated herself to bringing others to the Institute, facilitating their journeys in French, and integrating holistic wellness into the corporate world.

Listen in as Roxane shares compelling stories of recovery and rejuvenation, including a participant who lost 14 pounds and rediscovered his vitality, and another who found relief from lifelong psoriasis. Discover the importance of lifestyle changes, emotional healing, and the power of positive thinking in achieving true health and happiness.

Whether you’re curious about holistic health, seeking inspiration for your wellness journey, or interested in integrating wellness into your professional life, this episode is a must-listen. Tune in to learn how to transform your life and the lives of those around you.
